oneLine: Auto parts maker files DRHP for a Rs 440 crore IPO issue.

sources.title: Upcoming IPO: Auto parts maker files DRHP for Rs 440 crore issue — What investors should know?

synopsis: Arete 22 Limited, an integrated precision aluminium mobility solutions company headquartered in Andhra Pradesh, has filed its Draft Red Herring Prospectus with SEBI to raise up to Rs 440 crore through a fresh issue of equity shares. The company plans to use Rs 150 crore from the net proceeds for working capital requirements, Rs 120 crore for the repayment or prepayment of certain borrowings, and approximately Rs 34.82 crore for purchasing plant and machinery for its existing manufacturing facilities, with the remainder allocated for general corporate purposes. Unistone Capital Private Limited is acting as the banker to the issue, and Bigshare Services Private Limited is the registrar.
